episodes.title: Good News About Hell
probes: A woman wakes disoriented, face-down on a long empty conference table, and a voice over a speaker asks who she is.
A new hire sits alone in a bare room watching an orientation video explaining the procedure she has undergone.
A man makes small talk with his elderly next-door neighbour outside his house in the company-subsidized town.

episodes.title: Half Loop
probes: A small welcome party with snacks is thrown on the severed floor for the new hire, hosted by the deputy floor manager.
Irving sees black liquid spreading across the surface of his desk while working at his terminal.
Helly sits at her terminal for the first time, learning to sort cryptic numbers on screen into categories.

episodes.title: In Perpetuity
probes: Irving leads the group through a wing of the office devoted to the company founder and his family dynasty.
While Mark is at work, Devon and Ricken drop a copy of Ricken's self-help book on his doorstep.
Cobel sits at Lumon paging through a paperback self-help book, scanning it for hidden messages.

episodes.title: The You You Are
probes: Mark hides Petey's phone away, noticing several missed calls from the same blocked number.
Mark quietly holds on to Ricken's self-help book rather than handing it over to management as promised.

episodes.title: The Grim Barbarity of Optics and Design
probes: Mark drives out to a rustic birthing lodge in the woods, where Devon and Ricken are staying.
At home, Mark keeps working through Ricken's self-help book, struck by how anti-establishment its ideas are.

episodes.title: Hide and Seek
probes: Mark, out on a date with his sister's midwife, ends up at a loud punk-rock show singing along to a protest song.
A new keycard-locked door goes in at the entrance to the Macrodata Refinement corridor.
Irving brings the refiners along to Optics and Design so Mark can pitch the two departments working together.

episodes.title: Defiant Jazz
probes: Milchick puts on music and leads the whole department in a dance session, awarded to them as Helly's prize.
A dance party breaks out at the desks, with one of the refiners refusing to join in the moves.

episodes.title: What's for Dinner?
probes: Dylan wears a Kier Eagan mask, seated in a replica of Kier's bedroom while ritualistic dancers perform before him.
Outside work, Mark turns up at Ricken's book-reading party and ends up chatting with his neighbor Mrs. Selvig.

episodes.title: The We We Are
probes: Cobel drives fast while phoning Milchick, no longer bothering with her friendly neighbour voice.

episodes.title: Hello, Ms. Cobel
fine: Milchick leads the team into a completely renovated Break Room, promising far better working conditions from now on.

episodes.title: Goodbye, Mrs. Selvig
probes: Devon is uneasy, pressing Mark about the possibility that Gemma might still be alive somewhere.

episodes.title: Who Is Alive?
probes: Mark and Helly walk the severed floor's corridors handing out missing-persons posters of Ms. Casey to other departments.
Irving carries one of the posters down to O&D, bringing along his sketch of the dark hallway.
A woman from Lumon approaches Ricken about producing a special edition of his self-help book for innies.

episodes.title: Woe's Hollow
probes: A prerecorded message from Milchick greets the team and announces an outdoor team-building retreat away from the severed floor.
Along the way the group is directed by strange costumed doppelgängers of themselves.
Milchick and Miss Huang have set up a campsite for the group beside a waterfall.

episodes.title: Trojan's Horse
probes: Milchick sits through his first performance review as department head, his kindness reforms picked apart point by point.
fine: Ricken sits down to rework his book into a Lumon edition, stuffed with company-approved language, while Devon looks on unhappily.

episodes.title: Attila
probes: Milchick takes time off from the floor to work through his listed infractions, leaving the child deputy manager in charge.

episodes.title: Chikhai Bardo
probes: A flashback shows Mark and Gemma first meeting while lying side by side at a blood drive.
Long stretches of the episode play out in flashback, following Mark and Gemma through the early years of their marriage.
fine: In flashback, Mark and Gemma sit through an appointment at a fertility clinic after months of trying for a baby.

episodes.title: Sweet Vitriol
probes: Cobel returns to the rundown seaside town of her childhood, where the shuttered Lumon ether factory once supported everyone.
Cobel walks into a small-town restaurant looking for an old friend, who then quietly drives her out to her family house.
Cobel pushes past a protesting relative into her childhood home and ends up crying herself to sleep on an old bed.

episodes.title: The After Hours
probes: Mark phones in sick, telling Milchick he will definitely be in at work the following day.

episodes.title: Cold Harbor
probes: Milchick leads a marching band through the corridors of the severed floor, staging an elaborate celebration for the department.
